slice: terra-firma mainnet slice (7 contracts on Robinhood Chain 4663 + web/api)

fuzz.target: contracts/test/stress-p5.t.sol testFuzz_buyFeeAndSweepAccounting, testFuzz_joinOnlyWithExactInvite, testFuzz_sweepAboveMaxReverts (48 runs each, mainnet fork) + base testFuzz_stakingAccounting

paths.vector: TerraRouter buy/sell/convert ETH and token flows (fee exact, router keeps no ETH, Jar backed)
Router executes caller-supplied UR commands / route-token mismatch
Jar credit by non-router / withdraw beyond own balance / stranger withdraw
WifStaking notifyReward by non-FeePool, JIT stake, overdraw, early withdraw
FeePool distribute: sandwich of burn leg bounded by MAX_WIF_BUY_ETH, once per epoch, threshold
HindsightLens mintCard: burns exactly 1e18, no burn on fabricated round, needs approval
FriendJar exit isolation under invite replay
Stale Chainlink feed priced into a stock leg

findings.summary: 20 concurrent cold Hindsight cards: 6 requests died as platform 504 at the 60 s function limit instead of a handled 503
/card/[addr] page + OG image built the card server-side with no deadline (same 504 path on page render)
Cold-card capacity is bounded by the public RPC eth_getLogs rate limit (429); HyperSync (P5.0) needs Dami's Envio token
FriendJar invite travels in plaintext calldata: after the first join anyone can replay it (membership only lets you add your own ETH; exit isolation proven). UI gated off.
mintCard takes self-reported buys (an empty or fabricated card can be minted); /board ranks only cards re-derived by /api/card-check (API-CC-02 proves a 100x fabricated claim does not verify)
Keeper only fires at >= 0.0002 ETH while the contract floor is 0.00001 ETH: low-volume epochs need a manual distribute (by design, gas)
